scope: Java/Rust backend parity probes plus scoped live shadow evidence

not_covered: Java Reload execution; Rust intentionally leaves Reload to the Java boundary

not_proven: Complete live Java-primary/Rust-shadow comparison against the full Paper/world corpus; the scoped Paper 26.2-112 run compared two paths with zero mismatches.
Paired Java/Rust HTTP request semantics, full replay convergence, and production-equivalent sidecar fault/reconnect proof.
End-to-end performance/RSS, remote release publication and five-target resolution, rollback, observation, and clean cutover.
required_prerequisites: Pinned production-equivalent Java plugin and Paper artifacts plus the manifest-matching sidecar artifact.
Non-empty deterministic Paper world corpus and isolated runtime ports/directories.
A runner that can start Paper, exercise HTTP/control/replay/fault scenarios, and collect artifacts.
Independent report retention for each Java-primary/Rust-shadow scenario.
